original_datasets.name: AEJApp-2009-0289 household data

summary_statistics.info: 1666 rows, 85 columns. 'caste' categorical with 3 levels (ST/SC: 631; Back agr: 600; Back oth: 435).

original_datasets.notes: Original AEJ Applied article data. 'caste' includes 'ST/SC' treated as low-caste for grouping; all others combined as comparison. T-tests use household-level total income (totinc).

tasks.task_instruction: Conduct the analysis without additional restriction.

analysis_path.path_description: Compare total household income between low-caste (ST/SC) and other castes using a t-test.
preprocessing_steps: Identify caste categories and total income variable.
Define groups: low-caste = ST/SC; other castes combined.
Subset to non-missing totinc and caste.

key_choices.data_processing: Group households by caste; compute Welch's t-test.
key_choices.inference_rule: p-value threshold not stated; report p-value and t-statistic.

main_predictor.name: caste
main_predictor.definition: Household caste category; low-caste defined as ST/SC, compared to all others.

analysis_code.notes: Python translation created to implement the planned t-test using the original household data.

tasks.notes_for_agent: Follow this planned path; do not change the focal claim, dataset, or analysis goal.

tasks.task_instruction: Do not use District controls, Crop controls, Distance controls, Groundwater controls, Public goods controls. Do not include Irrigation, credit, and tenancy variables, and their interaction term versions. Do not use instruments for water buyer status.

analysis_path.path_description: Run a t-test of total income between low-caste (ST/SC) and other castes without any controls.
preprocessing_steps: Identify caste categories and total income variable.
Define groups: low-caste = ST/SC; other castes combined.
Subset to non-missing totinc and caste.

key_choices.data_processing: Group households by caste; compute Welch's t-test.
key_choices.inference_rule: p-value threshold not stated; report p-value and t-statistic.

main_predictor.name: caste
main_predictor.definition: Household caste category; low-caste defined as ST/SC, compared to all others.

analysis_code.notes: Uses the same Python script; it emits separate JSON output entries for Task1 and Task2.

tasks.notes_for_agent: Use the raw comparison without adding controls or instruments.

files.data/analysis__py.py: Python script that loads household.dta from /app/data, runs Welch t-tests of totinc by caste (ST/SC vs others) for Task1 and Task2, and writes JSON outputs to /app/data/outputs.

codebase.notes: Original reanalysis mentioned Stata, but per RUN POLICY the procedure is translated to Python. Ensure that /app/data contains the AEJApp-2009-0289-data folder and household.dta at runtime.

analysis.instructions: Execute Task1 and Task2 using the original household.dta dataset. Run the Python entry file and capture JSON outputs in /app/data/outputs.
not_allowed_actions: replace the planned path with a different analysis path

debugging_rule.repair_scope: fix dependency, file path, or output extraction issues only; do not redesign the analysis.

analysis.comparison_metrics: Welch t-test statistic, degrees of freedom, p-value, group means and sample sizes, and brief conclusion text whether low-caste (ST/SC) income is higher than others.
